messages.subject: rapache 1.1.8 works with R 2.9.0
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Just updated the website with a new version that supports R 2.9.0. The
main change was passing R's C level strict type checking.

Jeff

messages.subject: Re: rapache 1.1.8 works with R 2.9.0
messages.body_plain:
Very nice! Are you caching your png's after you create them? It will
certainly speed up your app, not that it's slow by any means right
now.

Caching helped a great deal with this app:

http://data.vanderbilt.edu/rapache/bbplot

Best,

Jeff
